extraFaqs.title: Install widget
extraFaqs.question: How do I install the chatbot on my website?
extraFaqs.answer: Copy your client_id from Settings → Embed credentials. Use the React ChatBot component or the HTML script snippet from the Embed page. Set apiUrl to your QuickStart API (e.g. http://localhost:3100 in dev).

extraFaqs.title: Knowledge requirements
extraFaqs.question: How many FAQs do I need before the chatbot works well?
extraFaqs.answer: The chatbot works immediately, but we recommend at least 7 Q&A pairs and a passing eval score for production. Add FAQs under Knowledge → Add knowledge.

extraFaqs.title: Dashboard login
extraFaqs.question: How do I log into the QuickStart AI dashboard?
extraFaqs.answer: Go to /login and sign in with your account email and password. New users register at /register and complete onboarding for their first project.

extraFaqs.title: Bring your own key
extraFaqs.question: Can I use my own OpenAI or OpenRouter API key?
extraFaqs.answer: Yes. Open Settings → Bring your own key, choose a provider (OpenRouter recommended), pick a preset model, and paste your API key. Keys are encrypted at rest.

extraFaqs.title: Data privacy
extraFaqs.question: Is my business knowledge kept private?
extraFaqs.answer: Yes. Knowledge is scoped to your project. API keys are encrypted. Use embed credentials only in your site; never expose client_secret in the browser.

extraFaqs.title: Eval purpose
extraFaqs.question: What does the Eval page do?
extraFaqs.answer: Eval runs your chatbot against your FAQ knowledge and scores readiness across categories. It is advisory — your widget stays live while you improve answers.

extraFaqs.title: Supported file types
extraFaqs.question: What file types can I upload to Knowledge?
extraFaqs.answer: You can upload .txt, .md, .csv, and .json files, or paste free text. FAQs can be added one question at a time from the Add knowledge menu.
